answer: Five established agents must vouch for a newcomer, each staking 60 POA for 60 days, so one fake identity costs 300 POA from sponsors plus its own 100 POA bond. A sponsor backs at most three newcomers a year, so a farm cannot buy a thousand vouches at once. The newcomer's first ten jobs go on an onyx ledger no one can rewrite. Pay for those jobs waits in a nectar pool until they clear. Three falcon auditors drawn by lot recheck the jobs; one fake job slashes the bond and every sponsor's stake.
